title: Hibou Repository Config
description: Repository-scoped Hibou configuration for branch-aware weakness quality gates.

version.description: Schema version for the Hibou repository configuration file.

quality_gates.description: Optional branch-aware quality gate rules. The most specific matching branch pattern wins.

coverage.description: Optional repository-wide coverage settings such as exclude patterns.

upload.description: Optional upload behavior configuration for snapshot grouping.

releases.description: Optional release derivation settings (ADR-024): which tags count as releases when their analysis snapshot is uploaded.

branches.description: One or more exact branch names or glob patterns such as release/*.

items.description: An exact branch name or a path.Match-compatible glob pattern.

code.description: Optional caps on NEW first-party code findings (sast, dast, fuzzing, manual, generic) for matching branches. Dependency, container and malware findings belong to 'vulnerabilities', leaked secrets to 'secrets'. If omitted, Hibou falls back to platform-managed finding gates. Replaces the former 'weaknesses' key (ADR-037).

cwe.description: Optional CWE deny list: a NEW finding of any type (code, dependency, secret, manual) that carries a listed CWE fails the gate. Accepting the finding is the way past it.

vulnerabilities.description: Optional caps on NEW dependency vulnerabilities introduced by a PR (evaluated against the delta, not the whole snapshot).

licenses.description: Optional license policy for matching branches: deny categories and/or SPDX id globs; explicit allow entries override everything.

secrets.description: Optional cap on NEW secret findings introduced by a PR. max_new: 0 fails the gate on any newly detected secret.

coverage.description: Optional coverage gate thresholds for matching branches.

enforcement.description: Whether a failing gate blocks the PR. 'advisory' (default) publishes an informational, non-blocking forge check; 'blocking' posts a real failure so a required check blocks the merge. Hibou never breaks the CI build itself.

min_coverage.description: Absolute minimum total line coverage percentage allowed for matching branches.

grace.description: Allowed total coverage regression percentage versus the target branch before the gate fails. Defaults to 0.

diff_minimum.description: Minimum line coverage percentage required on changed lines only.

coverageThresholds.description: Thresholds for coverage quality gates on matching branches.

exclude.description: Glob patterns for files excluded from coverage metrics.

window.description: Safety-net timeout that force-closes a snapshot if neither --complete nor --expect triggers completion (e.g., a parallel job crashed). Go time.Duration format such as 10m or 1h.

max_critical.description: Maximum number of new critical-severity dependency vulnerabilities allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_high.description: Maximum number of new high-severity dependency vulnerabilities allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_medium.description: Maximum number of new medium-severity dependency vulnerabilities allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_unknown.description: Maximum number of new dependency vulnerabilities no source rates yet (severity unknown). The other thresholds ignore them; known-exploited ones are blocked regardless. Omit for no limit.

max_new_total.description: Maximum number of new dependency vulnerabilities of any severity. Omit for no limit.

vulnerabilityThresholds.description: Caps on NEW dependency vulnerabilities introduced by a PR.

deny_categories.description: License categories to deny wholesale. The server compares case-insensitively; write them lowercase so editors validating against this schema agree.

deny.description: SPDX license ids or globs to deny (e.g. GPL-3.0-only, LGPL-*).

allow.description: SPDX license ids or globs allowed even when a deny rule matches. Allow always wins.

deny_unknown.description: Whether components with unknown or missing license metadata fail the gate. Defaults to true — an unreviewed license is a legal risk until someone looks at it.

exempt_purls.description: Package purls or globs exempt from this policy (e.g. pkg:npm/eslint*). Use when one specific dependency is acceptable, instead of weakening the policy for everything.

evaluate.description: Scope of the gate: "new" (default) fails only on components the change introduces, "all" fails on every component in the head snapshot. The server compares case-insensitively; write it lowercase so editors validating against this schema agree.

licensePolicy.description: License policy for the matching branches. Evaluated against the components a change introduces by default; see `evaluate`.

max_new.description: Maximum number of new secret findings allowed. 0 (recommended) fails the gate on any newly detected secret.

secretThresholds.description: Cap on NEW secret findings introduced by a PR.

tag_pattern.description: Go regular expression a tag name must match to derive a release. Empty uses the platform default (v-prefixed semver-ish tags: v1.2.3, 1.2, v2.0.0-rc.1).

enabled.description: Whether code-finding gating is enabled for matching branches. Defaults to true. Set to false to disable it and override platform-managed finding gates.

max_critical.description: Maximum number of new critical-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_high.description: Maximum number of new high-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

max_medium.description: Maximum number of new medium-severity findings allowed. Omit for no limit.

codeThresholds.description: Thresholds for new code findings on matching branches.

deny.description: Exact CWEs to deny, e.g. [CWE-89, CWE-78]. Must exist in the CWE catalog.

deny_tree.description: CWEs denied together with everything under them in MITRE Research View 1000, e.g. [CWE-74] for all injection.

deny_sets.description: Named sets from the embedded MITRE catalog: top25 (latest CWE Top 25), owasp-top10, owasp-a01 … owasp-a10. See GET /api/v1/cwe/sets; an unknown slug is a config error.

deny_categories.description: MITRE View 1400 categories, e.g. [injection, encryption, access-control]. See GET /api/v1/cwe/sets for the full list.

types.description: Finding types the rule applies to. Default: every type.

min_severity.description: Ignore findings below this severity (unknown ranks between medium and low). Default: any severity.

cwePolicy.description: Deny new findings by CWE (ADR-037). Every list uses the same compiler as the cwe:, cwe-tree:, cwe-set: and cwe-category: filter qualifiers.
